serverRead.sql: SELECT id,tool_name,invoked_at,serving_host,serving_process_id,serving_build_sha FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND coord_owner_id='su-3cf167ac-da89-444f-b45f-4605d51bf16d' AND id IN (44213849,44213903,44213939,44214041,44214170,44214171,44214242) ORDER BY id
serverRead.scope: These columns identify the process that recorded each selected tool settlement. They are separate from caller identity, native carrier binding and database row-mutation history.

inspection: projected-tool-deps.ts: recordToolInvocation obtains getServingHostIdentity() and persists its host, processId and buildSha in serving_host, serving_process_id and serving_build_sha.
serving-host-identity.ts: processId is a kernel-backed process-incarnation identifier. The cached buildSha comes from getBuildInfo().sha; null is not replaced by a current checkout SHA at this layer.

build-info.ts: a baked bundle SHA takes precedence, then PAPERCUSP_BUILD_SHA, then a development-host one-time Git fallback. The selected invocation rows do not record which resolution branch supplied their SHA.
writerSemantics.limitation: Recorded build identity plus repository blob equality is not an independent attestation of every byte loaded into the historical process. No historical bundle manifest or loaded-module digest is established here.

namedSourceComparison.method: Resolve the serving SHA as a Git commit; SHA256 each of the five superproject blobs. Resolve libs/papercusp through that commit's gitlink and SHA256 the sixth SQL blob in the submodule. Compare every result with the immutable prior supplement and current tree bytes.

submodule.scope: A repository source pin; it does not prove the historical database had this function installed.

sourceInspection: activity:report inserts an activity record using the payload owner.
agent-activity-bus.ts registers PG LISTEN consumers; ownerFromPayload extracts the notified owner and fans it out to local handlers.
dbos/bootstrap.ts arms startPlanItemActivityRenewal. That subscriber forwards its notified owner into renewOwnerActivityClaims, through each managed workspace.

renewOwnerActivityClaims filters UPDATE by owner equality and a non-expired lease. That inspected predicate describes the source behavior; selected tool settlement rows do not record the asynchronous UPDATE's executing process or affected row images.
asynchronousRenewalBoundary.verdict: The seven request-serving stamps do not identify which activity-bus consumer executed a historical renewal, or establish that a particular renewal occurred.
missing: The historical renewal consumer's execution identity and loaded-source provenance.
